we are not just about the physical form of cities but the social form of cities as well.
we need to make cities more green, more growing, and more just.

The main takeaway from our work is that
planners are not passive agents of social forces, but are actively engaged in creating and recreating the cities we live in.
sustainable development is not a single goal, but a process of resolving conflicts among three fundamental aims of planning: environmental protection, economic development, and social equity.
